calling_convention.inputs: $fp points to the receiver fighter; $gp selects whether direction words are retained or negated; $ra is saved through a shared setup tail
calling_convention.return: $t2 retains the allocated type-0x1a record; control returns through the $ra value stored at 0x88087274

reads: allocator state and animation-table entry through called verified routines
writes: one newly allocated and cleared secondary-object record
type, placement, motion, scale, flags, and animation state within that record

original.discovery_notes: Reached organically from receiver-side emission block 0x88003d30 during a controlled Jago Endokuken hit on idle Fulgore. The first live call uses countdown 0x30 and height byte 0x55, allocates 0x8808c000, and installs animation index 12. The body jumps backward to shared setup tail 0x8800b1d8, which calls verified animation initializer 0x880063ac.

commands: flatpak run org.mamedev.MAME kinst -rompath assets/ki1 -debug -nodrc -debugscript mame/oracle_ki15d_8800b1fc.cmd -video none -sound none -nothrottle -skip_gameinfo -seconds_to_run 5 -cfg_directory work/mame/cfg -diff_directory work/mame/diff
verification.notes: Four controlled full-constructor calls cover the exact first live particle, both $gp orientation branches, a skipped occupied pool record, the computed-scale range, the 0x1a scale boundary, byte masking, and 32-bit position wrapping. The native test composes the two already verified dependencies and compares the complete 1 MiB mapped RAM image after every call.
